_comment: Hand-authored. Unused $FF fill at the ends of banks.

regions.name: Fill: 21 x $FF
regions.description: Between the end of bank 0's JMP table ($8000-$801A, nine entries) and the tile-block pointer table at $8030 that $D842 names. All $FF; no reader. Space for seven more JMP entries, unused.

regions.name: Fill: 37 x $FF
regions.description: 37 bytes of $FF running from the end of the bank's last claimed structure to $BFFE, the byte before the bank-identity byte at $BFFF that the reset path checks. No reader has been found; $FF is the erased-EPROM value, so this reads as unused space.
